body.message:
This is honestly getting ridiculous.

I’ve followed up more than 10 times about my deposit and I still haven’t received it. Why is it taking this long to return my money?
And now you’re not even replying to my messages for days. This is really unprofessional and honestly very frustrating.
I’ve been patient enough. Please stop ignoring my messages, tell me clearly what’s going on, and return my deposit ASAP.
